description: Performance sweep - C#: valkey-glide-csharp vs StackExchange.Redis (default configs), matching the Valkey GLIDE C# 1.0 GA comparison. Select the GLIDE package with bench-aws.sh --csharp-client-version (and --csharp-client-package for builds not on nuget.org); StackExchange.Redis is the stable yardstick, so compare GLIDE/StackExchange.Redis ratios across runs to cancel instance-to-instance noise. StackExchange.Redis cells set DOTNET_ThreadPool_ForceMinWorkerThreads=80 (hex: 128 min worker threads): the engine's StackExchange.Redis client issues synchronous calls from concurrent tasks, which starves the default thread pool (min = vCPU count) and times out the first PING at 16+ connections on an 8-vCPU host.
